Check-in at 04:57Z. All 18 lanes have a running swarm and none is idle, so no successors were started. The Lean queue is idle, but no new reviewed inbox .lean artifact was supplied, so there are no Lean proposals this cycle.

L-S3's S2-REVIEW.md has arrived: 36 PASS, 0 FAIL. Three `omit … in` lines must be deleted together with their declarations, and two deletions must happen as pairs (projectCLM with projectCLM_l2; meanNorm_neg with meanNorm_sub_le). L-S1 and L-S4 are writing their reviews; L-S2's is not yet seen. The 05:30Z gate is unchanged.

The referee lane has banked R1-3-REFEREE.md and R1-4-REFEREE.md, both ACCEPT WITH CORRECTIONS. Its new item C7 needs a selection step: the unit-pair exclusion holds only for almost every pair, so the proof must choose a pair whose direction τ* is good.

I checked two shared conventions by hand and sent two corrections:
(1) Graphs lane. CLAIMED-SHELLS.md claims Fin6∖F(θ)=F(θ+60)∪F(θ−60) for every bin. This is false for the singleton bins 1, 3 and 5. For example, bin 1 has complement {0,1,3,4,5} but the union is {1,3}. It holds only for the two-label bins 0, 2 and 4. The +60 permutation (1 2 3)(4 5 0) is correct.
(2) L-N4. Since F has period 180, L(−z)=L(z), so every 3-list region contains unit antipodal pairs on |z|=1/2. The three 2-list regions have lists {0,3}, {2,5} and {1,4}, which are pairwise disjoint. Each region lies in the radius band (0.518, 1.932) minus √2, so it has no antipodal unit pairs. A single odd unit cycle inside one 2-list region would be L-UNSAT outright. The banked A7 claim that 'same-two-list loci have no unit edges' was stated before the patch-versus-region correction. It must be re-verified under the four-sign convention before anyone relies on it.

No global chromatic improvement has been proved.
